column3: Kraków shooting suspect who killed six has died, say police in Poland (波蘭警方表示，克拉科夫槍擊案造成六人死亡的嫌疑人已身亡)
Terrorism investigation was opened after a 24-year-old opened fire in a market square on the weekend (一名 24 歲男子週末在市集廣場開槍後，當局已展開恐怖主義調查)
The suspect... had been in critical condition in hospital. (該名嫌疑人當時在醫院處於危急狀態。)
Trump says he was ‘only kidding’ about making UFC’s Dana White next press secretary (川普表示任命 UFC 總裁 Dana White 為下一任新聞秘書只是「開玩笑」)

Trump said on Sunday that he “was only kidding” when he announced a day earlier that he had offered the job of White House press secretary to Dana White (川普週日表示，當他前一天宣布已向 Dana White 提供白宮新聞秘書一職時，他只是在開玩笑)
but can his reputation survive the news of his affair? (但他的名聲能挺過這場外遇新聞嗎？)
What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy? (關於輝達執行長與疑似中國間諜的外遇事件，我們知道些什麼？)
Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven (埃及兩列火車相撞，造成至少七人死亡)
President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision (總統在火車相撞脫軌後下令立即進行調查)
Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided (兩列火車相撞時，造成七人死亡，至少 125 人受傷)
How a bank collapse left millions in limbo and toppled Paraguay's president (銀行倒閉如何讓數百萬人陷入困境並導致巴拉圭總統下台)
A bank's collapse in Paraguay... exposed a web of political and financial ties. (巴拉圭一家銀行的倒閉揭露了政治與金融關係的網絡。)
